description: Internal alterations comprising the replacement of modern bathroom fittings and sanitary ware with upgraded traditional designs; reinstatement of missing cornices, skirtings, and a historic half-landing door opening; removal of modern joinery and boxing; application of wallpaper using reversible methods; replacement of lighting fittings using existing positions and reinstatement of a pendant light; and general refurbishment with period-appropriate finishes

Replacement of consented kitchen with upgraded units - no change to layout - in
keeping with character of property. Re-instatement of gas connection behind skirting.
Installation of extractor fan without ducting, and two additional electric sockets.
